description: Get the historical ESG composite trend for a specific entity by LEI. Returns score history, trend direction (IMPROVING / STABLE / DETERIORATING), and delta over the requested window. Data accumulates each time the entity is scored via esg.lookup, esg.batch, or esg.portfolio. Useful for due diligence, MiCA Article 72 ongoing monitoring reports, and detecting counterparties whose ESG posture is degrading.
name: esg.trend
